parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of NaN comparison in the Bareiss algorithm but may not be sufficient to handle all cases of symbolic matrices.

issues.description: The patch only modifies the cancellation of the result in the Bareiss algorithm, which may not fully resolve the issue for all symbolic matrices. The Bareiss algorithm is not inherently valid for symbolic matrices, and this change does not address the underlying problem.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the issue is fully resolved and that the change does not introduce new regressions.
